method: Computed each supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash, byte size and page count and compared all three against every established evidence catalog, published asset and prior duplicate index.
Extracted embedded text and rendered all nine supplied pages. Every page is readable and all three first pages are substantive.

Confirmed that each supplied file is byte-for-byte identical to its established born-digital MiWaters portal record. The three distinct submissions were retained once under their verified submission identities.
Verified the two existing local downloads, localized the remaining July 2018 interim report and reused its established first-page preview.
Added the previously unrepresented December 18, 2019 status event and separated it from EGLE's distinct December 3 statewide program-status letter.

records.canonicalName: 2018-07-30 - IPP PFAS interim report - Submission HNF-P7H3-DCN87 v1.pdf
records.verifiedFinding: Cadillac listed Wexford County Landfill as the only probable PFOS/PFOA source among the screened facilities, identified the landfill as participating in the waste-program initiative, reported source-sampling results pending and stated that POTW effluent had not yet been sampled.

records.canonicalName: 2019-06-28 - IPP PFAS status report - Submission HNQ-VZP8-TWNRX v1.pdf
records.verifiedFinding: Cadillac stated that it had determined Wexford County Landfill was its source, that the landfill had moved to deep-well injection and had said it would no longer bring leachate to Cadillac. The form lists June 4 effluent results of PFOS 7.1 ng/L and PFOA 15 ng/L at 2 MGD.

records.canonicalName: 2019-12-18 - IPP PFAS status report - Submission HNV-XK97-EV0GR v1.pdf
records.verifiedFinding: Cadillac again identified Wexford County Landfill as its confirmed PFOS source, stated that it was no longer accepting the landfill's leachate and recorded deep-well injection as the reduction method. The form lists October 22 effluent results of PFOS 2.4 ng/L and PFOA 3.4 ng/L at 1.98 MGD.

evidentiaryBoundary: These are certified Cadillac MiWaters submissions and preserve the City's source-identification, cessation and monitoring statements. They do not independently prove the exact final leachate delivery date, identify transaction-level loads or volumes, establish that deep-well injection began on a specific day, or demonstrate a groundwater migration pathway to Plett Road.

queueResolution.reason: The submissions strengthen the documented screening, confirmation and post-cessation sequence but do not supply the manifests, hauler tickets, invoices, WWTP receiving logs, synchronized treatment data, Plett receptor-series records or modern source-to-receptor pathway evidence still requested.
